title: PREX delegated adapter manifest and stdio protocol
description: Delegated adapter plugins answer registry-definition and catalog operations for third-party ecosystems. The host loads the manifest no-follow, executes only a bounded immutable snapshot of the operator-approved standalone executable through the fail-closed sandbox, passes a canonical request document on stdin, and validates every response against the normative PREX schemas before use. Inspection results may declare the executables a package provides; the stdio protocol carries metadata only, and artifact bytes are fetched host-side and verified against the published digest. Codec, installer, project-format and pack capabilities are not delegatable; undeclared capabilities fail closed.

DelegatedAdapterExecutable.$comment: Logical executable name used by plans and receipts, not an executable path. The host separately selects an approved absolute standalone source and executes its immutable snapshot at a private path.

DelegatedAdapterCapability.$comment: Version 1 delegates registry-definition and catalog surfaces. Codec, installer, project-format and pack capabilities are not delegatable and fail closed.

DelegatedAdapterCommand.$comment: Literal argv suffix appended after the immutable snapshot path for one operation. No templates, no shell text; the request document arrives on stdin.

DelegatedAdapterAuthority.$comment: Authority is a request, never a grant. The host separately requires user consent, offline-mode denial, and sandbox enforcement.

commands.$comment: One entry per operation the plugin implements. catalog capability requires identify, enumerate, inspect and fetch-artifact-record; snapshot remains optional.

environment.$comment: Static environment forwarded to every invocation after the operator allowlists each name. Values are literals, never secrets.

DelegatedAdapterRequest.$comment: Versioned canonical JSON the host writes to the plugin's stdin. It never contains environment values, credentials, sandbox controls, or ambient host state.

DelegatedAdapterResponse.$comment: Bounded canonical JSON the plugin writes to stdout. Error responses use a machine-readable code; hosts map failures to fail-closed provider errors. Result payloads MUST validate against the normative schema for the operation before the host uses them.

allOf.$comment: ok and result/error are correlated: a successful response carries a result, a failed response carries an error.

DelegatedAdapterWarning.$comment: Non-fatal provider warning attached to an inspection result.

DelegatedAdapterRecordResult.$comment: Wire shape of a provider record: the JSON body travels and the host reconstructs rawBody as its canonical bytes, so a plugin cannot desync the bytes from the body it answered with.

DelegatedAdapterBin.$comment: Executable declaration for a package a delegated provider serves. name is a single safe path segment; path is a relative POSIX path without absolute roots or '..' segments; entry is required iff interpreter is python (module:callable). Hosts validate before use and fail closed on anything else.

interpreter.$comment: Runtime the host invokes; absent means node. native executes the verified store file directly.

entry.$comment: Entry point in module:callable form; required iff interpreter is python.

DelegatedAdapterInspectionResult.$comment: Wire shape of a provider inspection: the catalog package instance, its provenance record, optional executable declarations, and optional non-fatal warnings.

DelegatedAdapterSnapshotResult.$comment: A snapshot result is exactly the normative SourceSnapshot wire shape.
